definitions.gloss: suddenly; all of a sudden; without warning
definitions.explanation: Something happens unexpectedly and without any prior indication. Emphasizes the abruptness of the event.

examples.japanese: {突然|とつぜん}に⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{突然|とつぜん}に⟦{訪|たず}ねて→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧きた。
examples.english: A friend suddenly came to visit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{突然|とつぜん}に⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧になった。
examples.english: The power suddenly went out in the middle of the meeting.

notes:
Can be used with or without the ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ particle — both ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ and {突然|とつぜん}に function as adverbs. The form without ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is slightly more common in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {突然|とつぜん}に⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: to appear suddenly
- {突然|とつぜん}に⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to collapse suddenly
- {突然|とつぜん}に⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}す→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧: to suddenly burst into tears
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧: a sudden visit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: suddenly — similar but often implies a change of state or speed
- ⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧: suddenly, without warning — more colloquial, emphasizes lack of preamble
- ⟦{不意|ふい}→不意：11351_fui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: unexpectedly — literary, emphasizes catching someone off guard
- ⟦{唐突|とうとつ}→唐突：09121_toutotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: abruptly — more formal, often about speech or behavior

USAGE:
⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ can also function as a な-adjective modifier: ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧ (a sudden notification).
